scores.evidence: Nothing is cut off and no screen scrolls sideways. At 390 px the TD mermaid loop-diagram labels are readable (pages/mobile-jp-04.png), and both 2-column tables fit without clipping (loop-table on mobile-jp-03, surfaces-table on mobile-jp-07). The pre-wrapped example-diff code also fits without soft-wrapping (mobile-jp-14/15). metrics.json has no hard failures: overflowX false, consoleErrors 0, mermaidErrors 0, unknownBlocks 0, brokenImages 0.

textOnlyScreens is empty on both desktop and mobile. Desktop JP median charsPerLine is 39, inside the 30–40 target. Every section breaks up its text with definitions, tables, code, steps or a check, and paragraphs stay short on every screen (for example desktop-jp-06 and mobile-jp-09).

All visible text is Japanese, with English glosses on the first use of each term (definitions on mobile-jp-04, 06 and 11), and the diagram labels are Japanese. Some small problems remain: commands in practice-checklist show as plain text instead of code (mobile-jp-21), and some quiz options on desktop leave a 1–2 character orphan on the second line (desktop-jp-15, desktop-jp-16).

niceToHave: practice-checklist: the labels 'claude --versionで…' and '/diffで…' show as plain bold text, not as code like everywhere else in the lesson (pages/mobile-jp-20.png, pages/mobile-jp-21.png, pages/desktop-jp-14.png, pages/desktop-jp-15.png). If checklist labels accept inline markdown, wrap them in backticks. Otherwise reword the labels, for example 'バージョン番号を表示できました'.

example-steps: each step shows two numbers, the reader's circle and the ① to ⑤ in the title ('1 ① 何をするプロジェクトか聞く', pages/mobile-jp-13.png, pages/desktop-jp-09.png). practice-steps refers to '1-5の①' and '1-5の⑤', so you could keep the circled numbers. Or drop them from the titles and change those references to '1-5の手順1' and '1-5の手順5'.

check-quiz q5 option a wraps on desktop and leaves only 'る' on the second line (pages/desktop-jp-15.png); shorten it, for example to 'Claude Codeはツールで自分から調べ、変更し、確かめる'. q7 option b does the same with 'れる' (pages/desktop-jp-16.png); a shorter version would be '有料プランかConsoleアカウントで、ネイティブインストーラーを使う'.
reader: the glossary sidebar ('用語・このレッスン') lists エージェントループ twice, once as 'エージェントループ (agentic loop)' and once as plain 'エージェントループ', on every desktop screen (for example pages/desktop-jp-03.png).
reader: the diff code block (example-diff, pages/desktop-jp-10.png) does not colour the added '+' lines, so learners can only spot them by the '+' character.

summary: The screenshots show the lesson under review (lessonHash sha256:83c7a256e5bf982c from metrics.json) and have no hard failures: no sideways overflow, console or mermaid errors, unknown blocks or broken images. All tables, the TD mermaid loop and the pre-wrapped code blocks are readable at 390 px. No privacy problems appear on any screen. There are no must-fix items; the most useful polish is showing the commands in practice-checklist as code and shortening the two exam options that leave a 1–2 character orphan on desktop.
